title: zazzle-llm deployment diagram
description: How zazzle-llm gets to a developer's machine and runs there. It is not installed with zazzle: the first `zazzle agent llm` or `zazzle agent prompt` makes the invoker exec `zazzled llm`, which downloads the binary for its own release from icelander.net/downloads/zazzle/vX.Y.Z/tools/PLATFORM/ into ~/.zazzle/v1/tools, checks its SHA-256 against the manifest compiled into zazzled and execs it. zazzle-llm then downloads the chosen model from huggingface.co into ~/.zazzle/v1/llm/models, runs it in its own process with llama.cpp (on the GPU through Metal on Apple Silicon) and exits. Nothing stays resident.

sources.symbol: Build, sign and list the JIT tools

nodes.name: Developer's terminal
nodes.description: Runs `zazzle agent llm ..` to choose a model and `zazzle agent prompt ..` to ask it.

nodes.name: Coding agent's shell
nodes.description: Runs `zazzle agent prompt ..`, often with standard input piped in, as agents/skills/zazzle-agent/SKILL.md says.
nodes.condition: When a coding agent follows the zazzle-agent skill.

nodes.name: Developer's machine
nodes.description: A Mac (universal binary; Metal on Apple Silicon, the CPU on Intel) or a Linux machine (x86_64 or aarch64, the CPU).

nodes.name: zazzle invoker
nodes.description: Replaces itself with `zazzled llm llm|prompt ARGS` for `zazzle agent llm|prompt`, without contacting the daemon.
nodes.condition: When run as zazzle (or z) with `agent llm` or `agent prompt`.

nodes.name: zazzled llm
nodes.description: The same process after exec: finds zazzle-llm beside zazzled or in the tool store, downloading it first, and replaces itself with it.

nodes.name: zazzle-llm
nodes.description: Lists or chooses models, or loads one, renders its chat template and streams the answer to the caller's standard output; exits 0, 2 on errors, 3 when the token limit cut the answer.

nodes.name: Tool store (~/.zazzle/v1/tools)
nodes.description: Downloaded JIT tools, made executable after their hash matched; ZAZZLE_TOOLS_DIR moves it.

nodes.name: Model store (~/.zazzle/v1/llm)
nodes.description: models/ with the installed GGUF files, partial downloads and lock files, and the `defaults` file with the chosen model and effort (0700 directories); ZAZZLE_LLM_DIR moves it.

nodes.name: icelander.net downloads
nodes.description: The R2 bucket behind icelander.net/downloads/zazzle, holding each release's tools under vX.Y.Z/tools/{macos-universal,linux-x86_64,linux-aarch64}/ with their manifest; ZAZZLE_TOOLS_URL replaces it.

nodes.name: huggingface.co
nodes.description: Serves each model file at the repository, commit and file name the catalogue pins (`/REPO/resolve/COMMIT/FILE`).

artifacts.name: zazzle-llm
artifacts.description: Built by macos/release/tools.sh: universal with lipo on macOS (Metal on the aarch64 half), signed and notarized when configured, one per Linux architecture; listed with its SHA-256 in the tool manifest the release compiles into zazzled. Also built with cargo build --release -p zazzle-llm and put beside zazzled.

artifacts.name: Model file (GGUF)
artifacts.description: One of the ten catalogue entries, a 4-bit (or MXFP4) quantization from 1.3 to 63 GB, accepted only with the size and SHA-256 the catalogue pins.
